View and valuation: Rolling forward our valuation to 18x average FY28–FY29E EV/EBITDA, we retain our 'BUY' rating with a target price of INR 350.

Aggressive capacity expansion backed by industry-leading capital efficiency: PARKHOSP remains on track to increase bed capacity by ~40% in FY27, having already commissioned 680 beds while targeting another 750 beds in H2FY27.
watch: While the near-term margin is negatively impacted by new hospital ramp-up and one-off cost pressure, we expect these transitory headwinds to normalise over the next few quarters.

Near-term headwinds remain transitory; long-term earnings outlook intact: The management forecasts the temporary drag from newly-commissioned hospitals to moderate as occupancy ramps up and insurance empanelment is completed, while cost pressure from higher consumables and patient-service enhancements are anticipated to normalise in the coming quarters.
